title: Open-Vocabulary Functional 3D Human-Scene Interaction Generation
notes: Core HSI. Training-free open-vocabulary functional 3D human-scene interaction generation; author page exposes a code link, but no verifiable official public repository was confirmed in review.

title: UniCon3R: Contact-aware 3D Human-Scene Reconstruction from Monocular Video
aliases: Unified Contact-aware 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction from Monocular Video
notes: Core HSI reconstruction. Uses contact as an internal corrective cue for feed-forward online human-scene reconstruction. Official repository is public, but README still says full code/checkpoints are coming soon.

title: Human3R: Everyone Everywhere All at Once
notes: HSI reconstruction / joint human-scene-camera modeling. Official repository includes installation, inference, evaluation, and training documentation.

title: GenHSI: Controllable Generation of Human-Scene Interaction Videos
notes: Core HSI generation in video form. Public project page and paper are available, but no verifiable official public GitHub repository was confirmed in this run.

title: HSImul3R: Physics-in-the-Loop Reconstruction of Simulation-Ready Human-Scene Interactions
notes: Core HSI reconstruction. Physics-in-the-loop optimization targets simulation-ready human-scene reconstructions, but the current public repository is still lightweight and mostly exposes the paper/project scaffold rather than a full runnable release.

title: InterPhys: Physics-aware Human Motion Synthesis in a Dynamic Scene
notes: Core-to-near-core HSI motion synthesis in dynamic scenes. The paper explicitly models human-object forces, human-scene forces, and internal body dynamics for physically grounded motion generation; as of 2026-05-19, no verifiable official public project page or code repository was confirmed in follow-up review.

title: CRISP: Contact-Guided Real2Sim from Monocular Video with Planar Scene Primitives
notes: Near-core to core HSI reconstruction / real2sim. Explicitly models human-scene contact, reconstructs interaction-relevant scene geometry including occluded support surfaces, and releases an official end-to-end pipeline plus RL transfer code.

title: GRAFT: Geometric Refinement and Fitting Transformer for Human Scene Reconstruction
notes: Core HSI reconstruction. Replaces slow geometry fitting with a fast geometry-grounded transformer prior for physically plausible human-scene contact, but the official repository still marks code release as pending.

title: AHA! Animating Human Avatars in Diverse Scenes with Gaussian Splatting
aliases: AHA Animating Human Avatars in Diverse Scenes with Gaussian Splatting
notes: Edge-related to HSI. Official public repository exists but currently only contains a short placeholder README; the main contribution is scene-grounded avatar animation / rendering rather than core HSI generation or reconstruction.

title: FunREC: Reconstructing Functional 3D Scenes from Egocentric Interaction Videos
notes: Edge-related but notable. The work reconstructs functional articulated scenes from egocentric interaction videos and is strongly interaction-aware, but its primary task is functional scene reconstruction rather than direct HSI generation or reconstruction; no verifiable official public code repository was confirmed in this run.

title: SHARE: Scene-Human Aligned Reconstruction
notes: Edge-related to HSI reconstruction. The paper grounds human motion with scene geometry and improves world-space alignment from monocular video, but its main framing is human placement / alignment rather than explicit interaction generation or contact-centric HSI modeling; no verifiable official public code release was confirmed in this run.

title: MOGRAS: Human Motion with Grasping in 3D Scenes
notes: Edge-related to HSI. The work is scene-aware and interaction-relevant, but is better framed as a full-body grasping dataset plus adaptation baseline in 3D scenes than as a core HSI generation or reconstruction method; no verifiable official public code repository was confirmed in this run.
